_comment: Central config for the whole camera-tracking validation project. Every node loads this same file so there is one place to change IPs, IDs, rates, and paths.

optitrack._note: rotor_rigid_body_id only used if you go the tracked-fixture route instead of a fixed CAD offset. required=false runs backend with no Motive/NatNet hardware at all (dev/demo mode) -- transform_sync will always report valid=false, since there's no camera data to match against. Set true once Motive is actually up.

fanuc._note: connection_mode: 'stub' = simulated poses, 'live' = real P2D2/FANUCLibrary link (not implemented yet)
